# Profound Raises $96M Series C at $1B Valuation

Profound raised $96M Series C at $1B unicorn valuation for its GenAI marketing intelligence platform. Helps enterprise brands optimize AI discovery across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and more with real-time analytics and agents.

Emel Kavaloglu

Feb 24, 2026

[Profound](https://tryprofound.com), a GenAI marketing intelligence platform, has raised $96M in Series C funding at a $1B valuation, achieving unicorn status.
The company equips enterprise brands and marketing teams with real-time analytics, competitive intelligence, automation agents, and actionable insights to optimize visibility in AI-driven discovery across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and emerging models like DeepSeek. The capital will accelerate development of the marketing platform for the AI era.

## Unicorn Surge in AEO Platforms

Profound's funding marks its rapid ascent to unicorn status less than two years after founding in 2024. This comes amid intensifying competition in answer engine optimization (AEO), where brands race to adapt to conversational AI replacing traditional search. Profound's broad AI ecosystem coverage differentiates it in a fragmented market.

## AI Discovery Erodes Traditional SEO

Enterprise marketers grapple with declining organic reach as users shift to AI chatbots for answers, bypassing Google-like SERPs.
Traditional SEO tactics fail against zero-click responses from models like ChatGPT and Perplexity.

## Comprehensive Analytics Across AI Engines

Profound delivers Answer Engine Insights, Agent Analytics, Prompt Volumes, Shopping tools, and customizable Agents. Unlike narrow SEO tools, it tracks performance across multiple LLMs in real-time, offering competitive benchmarking and automation. This holistic approach enables precise content optimization for AI responses.

## Automation Agents Redefine Marketing Workflows

Recent launches like Knowledge Bases and Contentful integration streamline content pipelines for AI readiness. Profound also ran experiments revealing optimal formats (markdown vs. HTML) for AI bots, providing data-driven guidance. Its platform empowers teams to monitor prompt volumes and shopping intents directly.

## $1B Valuation Signals AEO Imperative

The Series C round underscores investor conviction in Profound's vision amid explosive AI adoption.
Achieving unicorn status with 51-200 employees highlights efficient scaling and product-market fit. This growth capital positions Profound to expand platform capabilities and enterprise adoption.

## AEO Market Draws Heavy Investment

The nascent AEO sector is exploding as enterprises allocate budgets to AI visibility. Profound leads the G2 Winter Report 2026 for AEO tools, with customers like Ramp validating its enterprise readiness. Hosting the Zero Click conference cements its thought leadership in AI marketing.

## Rapid Growth Defines Leadership Edge

Founded in 2024, Profound scaled to unicorn velocity in under two years, a testament to its team's execution. With 150+ employees serving enterprise clients, it demonstrates lean innovation in a capital-intensive space. This trajectory signals a new benchmark for GenAI startups.
